_comment: Synthesized (Phase 20.6). Voyage's 429 envelope, hand-written in full: provoking a real quota rejection would mean sustained abuse of the live endpoint, so no recording exists. The `detail` key and its string-valued shape are copied from the genuine 400 envelopes under `recorded/`.
